Enum Class CompanyPermission

java.lang.Object

de.eldoria.companies.components.company.CompanyPermission
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<CompanyPermission>, Constable, net.kyori.adventure.translation.Translatable
public enum CompanyPermission extends Enum<CompanyPermission> implements net.kyori.adventure.translation.Translatable
A permission of a member within a company. Permissions are stored as a bit mask.
